title: Common Errors
markdown:
## Compiler errors

| Message | Usual cause | Fix | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| `';' expected` | A missing semicolon, often at the end of the line **before** | Add it | 1.01 |
| `cannot find symbol` | A typo, wrong case (`system.out`), a missing import, or a variable used outside its block | Check spelling and case; add the `import`; declare it in the right scope | 1.01 |
| `class X is public, should be declared in a file named X.java` | The public class and file name differ | Rename the file or the class | 1.01 |
| `incompatible types: String cannot be converted to int` | Assigning a value of the wrong type | Convert with `Integer.parseInt`, or fix the type | 1.02 |
| `incompatible types: possible lossy conversion from double to int` | A narrowing conversion without a cast | Cast `(int) x`, or use `Math.round` | 1.02 |
| `integer number too large` | A big literal without `L` | `8_100_000_000L` | 1.02 |
| `variable x might not have been initialized` | Reading a local variable before every path assigns it | Initialise it when declared | 1.02 |
| `missing return statement` | A path through a non-void method ends without `return` | Return (or throw) on every path | 2.01 |
| `bad operand types for binary operator '&&'` / `incompatible types: int cannot be converted to boolean` | Using a number as a condition | Compare: `if (n != 0)` | 1.03 |
| `non-static method m() cannot be referenced from a static context` | Calling an instance method from `main` without an object | Create an object, or make the method `static` | 3.02 |
| `X is abstract; cannot be instantiated` | `new` on an abstract class or interface | Create a concrete subclass | 3.04 |
| `X is not abstract and does not override abstract method m()` | A class misses an interface or abstract method | Implement it (public, same signature) | 3.04 |
| `unreported exception IOException; must be caught or declared to be thrown` | Calling a method that throws a checked exception | `try`/`catch` it, or add `throws IOException` | 4.04 |
| `local variables referenced from a lambda expression must be final or effectively final` | A lambda uses a variable that is reassigned | Don't reassign it, or use a stream result or an `AtomicInteger` | 6.01 |
| `the switch expression does not cover all possible input values` | A switch over a sealed type or enum misses a case | Add the case (or a `default`) | 3.05 |
| `generic array creation` / `cannot select from a type variable` | Trying `new T[]` or `T.class` | Use a `List<T>`, or pass a `Class<T>` | 4.01 |

## Exceptions at run time

| Exception | Usual cause | Fix | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NullPointerException` | Using a member of `null`: an unset field, a missing map key, unboxing a `null` | Initialise fields; check map results; use `getOrDefault` or `Optional` | 3.01 |
| `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` / `IndexOutOfBoundsException` | An index equal to `length`/`size()` or negative | Indexes run from 0 to `length - 1` | 2.02 |
| `NumberFormatException` | `Integer.parseInt` on text that is not a whole number | Catch it, or check the input first | 1.04 |
| `InputMismatchException` | `Scanner.nextInt()` met text | Read lines and parse them | 1.04 |
| `ArithmeticException: / by zero` | Integer division by 0 | Check the divisor | 1.03 |
| `ConcurrentModificationException` | Changing a collection inside an enhanced `for` over it | `removeIf`, an `Iterator`'s `remove`, or loop backwards with indexes | 2.03 |
| `UnsupportedOperationException` | Changing a `List.of(...)` or other unmodifiable collection | Copy it: `new ArrayList<>(List.of(...))` | 2.03 |
| `ClassCastException` | A cast to a type the object does not have | Use `instanceof` patterns | 3.03 |
| `StackOverflowError` | Recursion without a reachable base case | Fix the base case, or use a loop | 2.04 |
| `NoSuchElementException` | `next()` past the end, `Optional.get()` on empty, `Scanner` out of input | Check `hasNext`, use `orElse`, check `hasNextLine` | 6.03 |
| `IllegalStateException: stream has already been operated upon` | Using a stream twice | Create a new stream each time | 6.02 |
| `NoSuchFileException` | A wrong path or missing file | Check the path; `Files.exists`; handle the `IOException` | 4.05 |
| `IllegalArgumentException` (your own) | A method received a bad argument | Read the message; fix the caller | 4.04 |

## Wrong results without an error

| Symptom | Usual cause | Fix | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| `7 / 2` is 3 | Integer division | Use `7 / 2.0` or a cast | 1.03 |
| `"Total: " + 1 + 2` prints `Total: 12` | `+` joins strings left to right | Parenthesise the sum | 1.03 |
| Two equal strings are not `==` | `==` compares references | `equals` | 1.04 |
| `nextLine()` returns `""` after `nextInt()` | The line break was left in the input | Read whole lines and parse | 1.04 |
| `0.1 + 0.2 != 0.3` | Binary floating point | Compare with a tolerance; use `long` cents or `BigDecimal` for money | 1.02 |
| A large `int` became negative | Overflow | Use `long`, or `Math.addExact` | 1.02 |
| An array prints as `[I@1b6d3586` | Arrays have no readable `toString` | `Arrays.toString(a)` | 2.02 |
| `list.remove(1)` removed the wrong item | On a `List<Integer>` it removes index 1 | `list.remove(Integer.valueOf(1))` | 2.03 |
| Two `Integer`s with the same value are not `==` | `==` compares wrapper objects | `equals` | 2.03 |
| A `HashSet` holds "duplicates" of your objects | `equals` overridden without `hashCode` (or neither) | Override both, or use a record | 4.02 |
| A sort comparator gives a wrong order for big numbers | Comparing by subtraction overflows | `Integer.compare` or `Comparator.comparingInt` | 4.03 |
| A classic `switch` runs several cases | Missing `break` (fall-through) | Use the arrow form `case X ->` | 1.05 |
| A counter updated from threads is too low | A race condition | `AtomicInteger`, `synchronized`, or no shared state | 6.04 |
| A written file is empty or cut off | The writer was not closed or flushed | try-with-resources | 4.05 |
